<thought>The most intense peak (m/z 134.10955) is likely the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈133.102 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈11 % M+1) suggests about ten carbons. A formula with ten carbons and no heteroatoms, C₁₀H₁₃, has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 133.1017 Da, matching the observed mass within experimental error. Hence the molecular formula is C10H13.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H13</final_answer>
